Name: Kari's Delivery Service - A Seasonal Mailbox Mod
Author: kariiiii
Description:
[center][center][size=5][/size][/center][/center][center][center][/center][size=5][b]﻿Have you ever wanted to get your mail delivered by cute critters instead of digging in a boring mailbox everyday? ﻿[/b]
[/size][b][size=5]With Kari's Delivery Service it is now possible! Our little employees will bring you a lot of joy! 

[/size][/b][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/cL5hPAt.png[/img][/size]

﻿
[b][size=3]Installation [/size][/b][b][size=3]
[/size][/b]1. Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
2. Download the main file of this mod and extract it to your mods folder
[size=1]*T﻿o use the recolor download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ then go to options, find my mod and you can change it there[/size]. [size=1]This is optional.

﻿[/size][/center][center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ozbS8uM.png[/img][/center][b][size=3]Installation for Alternative Textures
[/size][/b]1. Download and install the latest version of ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿[center]2. Download AT version of this mod from "Optional Files" and extract it to your mods folder
3. Use Paint Bucket Tool to manually change textures.
[size=1]*You can use either vanilla or earthy recolor version. They are uploaded as separate mods.
[/size][/center][center][/center]
